contract_source: shipped call sites (phase5b_backend_install.py:659-681, 818-841) + wrapper signature (apply_phase2_4_1a_patches.py:335-358, apply_phase2_2_patches.py:233-262) + writer shapes (phase5b_4c_paged_writer.py)
status: code-traced; NOT executed this session (CPU-only). Geometry example = Qwen2.5-7B.

invariants.packed_last_dim_is_half_D: packed int4 K/V last dim == D // 2 (2 channels per uint8)
invariants.H_q_div_H_kv: H_q % H_kv == 0 (GQA group G = H_q // H_kv)
invariants.protect_is_compact: k_packed_protect_bf16 last dim == n_protect << D (compact sidecar, NOT full D)
invariants.k_group_is_block: packed_group_size == BS (K scale/xmin are per-block per-channel)
invariants.bf16_k_is_dummy: the positional k_cache is a bf16 dummy; content UNUSED on the packed path (only shape/seqlen matter)

arguments.name: k_cache (bf16 dummy)
arguments.role: DUMMY — zeros, content UNUSED on packed path; shape/seqlen contract only

arguments.name: v_cache (v_for_kernel)
arguments.role: V values as bf16 backing (when _bf16_v_mode) OR ignored in favor of v_packed_* kwargs

arguments.name: cache_seqlens
arguments.role: per-seq real token count; masks S - seqlen padded tail

arguments.name: block_table
arguments.role: paged block ids (BS-token blocks); may be pre-gathered host-side into the packed view

arguments.name: protect_mask
arguments.role: 1 where a K channel is protected (bf16 overlay), else 0; per-model frozen

arguments.name: causal
arguments.role: False for decode (query attends all cached)

arguments.name: k_packed_int4
arguments.role: packed INT4 K nibbles (low=even d, high=odd d)

arguments.name: k_packed_protect_bf16
arguments.role: COMPACT protected-K sidecar (n_protect of D channels)

semantics.batching: B sequences x 1 decode token; padded positions masked by cache_seqlens
semantics.block_table: paged BS=32-token blocks; padded block_id=0 positions contribute 0
semantics.partial_tail: last block partially filled (seqlen % BS); writer splices the K tail; kernel masks by cache_seqlens
semantics.gqa: H_q query heads share H_kv KV heads in groups of G=H_q/H_kv
semantics.protected_overlay: for channel d with protect_slot[h,d]>=0: K = k_packed_protect_bf16[..,slot]; else dequant(int4*scale+xmin)
semantics.scale_granularity: K per-block per-channel (group=BS); V per-token per-group (v_group_size)
